title: scripts/dev/ensure_kanbus.sh fails in cloud containers with a Debian-managed PyYAML
description: pip install kanbus==0.33.0 fails with 'Cannot uninstall PyYAML 6.0.1, RECORD file not found' because PyYAML is Debian-installed, so the SessionStart hook silently leaves kbs missing. Workaround that works: python3 -m venv, install the pinned kanbus there, symlink kbs. Fix: have the script create and use a venv (or pip install --ignore-installed). Also: kbs prompts about agent provenance; pass --agent-platform/--agent-model/--agent-name.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed 2026-10-19 in PR #52 (merged): ensure_kanbus.sh installs the pinned kanbus into a dedicated venv, symlinks kbs into ~/.local/bin, exports that dir through CLAUDE_ENV_FILE when off PATH, and the hook keeps stderr. Hermetic specs in tests/ensure_kanbus_script_test.py; real PyPI run printed kanbus 0.33.0; make check green. Still to observe: one real cloud session picking up kbs via CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.
